sourceSentences: [0] some of these Champs have a little bit higher regeneration than others for example Yas or aelia if we trade on to them they'll just regenerate it
[0] but TR as corki LeBlanc these are all Champs that don't have any regeneration that means that if you slow play into them and slowly chip away at the health bar
[0] the most important thing in these matchups is preserve your HP so that if they ever get on top of you they cannot onot you
[1] Pre level 3 syndra just don't take excessive amounts of her Q poke and you should be fine till level 6. once you hit 6 keep farming comfortably and avoid her E landing at all costs.
[1] If she gets lv 6 she can oneshot you with combo +R, be careful with her poke.
[1] Add on your low survivability and her Ultimate can become a major problem if she gets ahead.
